title: Marketplace bundle onboarding retrofit checklist and snippets
summary: Working checklist and copy snippets for retrofitting existing partner bundles so they meet cloud marketplace acceptance gates, telemetry requirements, and merchant UX expectations.
purpose: Provide a compact, actionable checklist for product, engineering, and legal to prepare bundle-style listings (multi-SKU offers) for marketplace publication. Includes quick copy variants that avoid legal/claims flags and a prioritized preflight for sprint T-2 weeks.
scope: Existing bundles that group multiple Redwood features (hosted API + dedicated commits + support add-ons)
Marketplace SKU mapping, trial entitlements, and tenant isolation notes
Copy variants for hero, short description, and trial CTA
Technical acceptance checks and smoke test matrix
acceptance_criteria: Tile hero + short description that passes legal review (no absolute performance claims)
Mapped SKUs with unique billing identifiers and entitlement rules for trials
Automated provisioning path for trial accounts with telemetry to identify trial conversions
Security checklist: SSO configured, KMS references documented, no shipping of customer data to third-party endpoints
Test matrix green: deploy test tenant, perform 100 request smoke test, verify latency SLO baseline within tolerated band
Monitoring hooks: tile-level telemetry exported to partner console with agreed metrics
preflight_checks_prioritized: Legal quick-scan: remove words like ‘guaranteed’, ‘zero-cost’, ‘unlimited’ from marketing copy
Billing: ensure SKU ids exist in billing system and map to marketplace rate card
Trial: verify trial provisioning API (createTrialAccount) returns expected entitlements within 90s
Tenant isolation: confirm no shared buckets or tokens exposed in listing examples
Telemetry: ensure event names and schema documented (trial.started, trial.converted, tile.installed)
Regional compliance: mark tiles with data residency supported regions
SLA: publish the supported SLA level and fallback behavior in the listing details
technical_acceptance_steps: Create a staging listing and run the marketplace validator tool (internal CLI)
Smoke test end-to-end provisioning via the marketplace flow using a test merchant account
Run tokenized calls through the Redwood API to verify routing rules (hosted -> dedicated fallback)
Verify billing events are emitted (billing.event.sku_purchase) and reconcile with test billing ledger
Confirm quota and rate-limits reflect marketplace plan entitlements
Validate log redaction and that no PII appears in exported logs during test runs
legal_flags_and_qa: Avoid comparative claims vs named competitors in tile copy
Clarify data handling: state that customer data remains in customer-owned projects or region when Private is selected
Include a short support escalation path for enterprise buyers in the listing details
Check trademark usage when partner logos are shown; require partner-signed asset release before publishing
Place a link to the full data processing addendum where required by the marketplace
copy_snippets_hero_variants: Redwood Inference: predictable LLM inference for production apps
High-throughput LLM serving for real-time products and analytics
Drop-in, production-ready inference with predictable latency and cost
copy_snippets_short_desc: Single API for hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Bundle includes reserved throughput and priority support.
Ship LLM features with consistent latency guarantees and simple billing. Includes trial credits and quickstart templates.
Production inference runtime tuned for throughput and cost, plus rollout controls and observability out of the box.
copy_snippets_bullets: Hosted API for fast prototyping and production traffic
Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput and isolation
Private deployment options for regulated or on-prem needs
Built-in tracing, per-route cost breakdowns, and canary rollouts
trial_cta_variants: Start a 14-day trial with pre-provisioned capacity
Try the bundle: instant sandbox and $500 trial credits
Get started: deploy a test tenant in 3 clicks
tile_microcopy_helptext: Trial provisioning may take up to 2 minutes while reserved capacity is allocated.
Billing only begins after trial conversion or after trial credits are exhausted.
Contact sales for enterprise network or KMS integrations.
edge_cases_and_risks: Partner bundling of third-party connectors may require separate legal review
Large commit sizes for Dedicated SKUs can exceed marketplace soft-limits—coordinate with infra quota team
SSO misconfiguration can block merchant onboarding—include a fallback manual verification process
If Private deployment is marked available but region unsupported, prevent tile purchase in that region
operational_playbook_snippets: If a merchant reports missing trial capacity: check provisioning job logs, escalate to infra on-call, and offer temporary sandbox keys
If billing events fail reconciliation: open billing-ops ticket with billing.event.trace id and merchant id
For legal takedown or content disputes: route to policy@redwood.ai and freeze new tile installs until resolved
launch_day_checklist: Final copy locked and legal-signed (no last-minute performance claims)
Billing SKUs live and end-to-end purchase tested
Telemetry dashboards provisioned and alert thresholds set
Support runbook published and on-call rotations notified
Partner marketing assets staged (logos, screenshots, quickstart)
